meta.name: benchling-integration
meta.description: Benchling Python SDK and REST API integration for registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, Benchling Apps, and Data Warehouse queries. Use when automating lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API.

copy.tagline: 自动将实验室数据集成到 Benchling
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常在 Benchling 中手动操作数据
copy.tagline_en: Automate lab data integration with Benchling.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently manage Benchling data manually.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 能用 Python 操作 Benchling 生物实验平台:创建 DNA/RNA 序列等注册实体、管理库存样本与容器、写电子实验记录、跑工作流、用 SQL 查数据仓库。需先配好租户地址与 API 密钥。
howto.when: 当你想用 Python 代码或 API 自动操作 Benchling 里的实验数据时触发,比如创建序列、管理库存、写实验记录等。

say.text: 在 Benchling 中创建 DNA 序列 My Plasmid,ATCG
say.note: 会调用 SDK 新建序列

say.text: 在 Benchling 中建样本管,放入 Freezer Box A1
用 SQL 查 Benchling 数据仓库,统计上周库存

howto.what_en: Claude can use the Benchling Python SDK/API to create DNA/RNA/protein registry entities, manage inventory, make ELN entries, run workflows, and query the data warehouse via SQL. Requires a configured tenant URL and API key.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to automate Benchling lab data with Python or its API, e.g., creating sequences, managing inventory, or writing notebook entries.

say_en.text: Create a DNA sequence My Plasmid with bases ATCG in Benchling
say_en.note: Creates the sequence via the SDK

say_en.text: Create a sample tube in Benchling and put it in Freezer Box A1
say_en.note: Creates a container and transfers it

say_en.text: Query the Benchling data warehouse with SQL for last week's inventory
